itens.titulo: Micron analysts stay bullish after another beat and raise as memory demand outlook extends into 2027
itens.descricao: Micron analysts stay bullish after another beat and raise as memory demand outlook extends into 2027 Yahoo! Finance Canada
trechos: Management said it sees sequential revenue and gross margin growth every quarter through fiscal 2027.
The company forecast fiscal first-quarter revenue well above expectations on Wednesday, after fourth-quarter revenue surged 379% from a year earlier to $54.23 billion.
The fourth-quarter figure compared with estimates of $51.07 billion.
Adjusted earnings per share came in at $33.42, ahead of the $31.61 estimate, while GAAP earnings per share were $32.87.
Bank of America reiterated its Buy rating and $1,550 price target, calling Micron a top AI pick.
The firm raised its fiscal 2027 and 2028 sales estimates by 20% and 30%, and lifted EPS forecasts to $172 and $198.
It noted that strategic customer agreements have grown to 26 from 16 last quarter, with take-or-pay terms covering about 35% of expected revenue through 2030.
UBS held its $1,625 target, saying the story is now about duration and capital return.

itens.descricao: Treasury 10-Year Yield Hits Highest Since 2002 on Rate Outlook Yahoo Finance
trechos: (Bloomberg) -- The US benchmark yield climbed to the highest since 2002 with persistent inflation, massive government borrowing and strong economic growth keeping interest-rate expectations elevated.
Most Read from Bloomberg The yield on the 10-year Treasury note rose as much as four basis points to 5.33%, rising past the 2007 peak, as oil prices rose.
The 30-year rate is also at the highest level since 2002.

itens.titulo: Dólar hoje sobe mais de 1% e ultrapassa R$ 5,20 por cautela com Treasuries
itens.descricao: Dólar hoje sobe mais de 1% e ultrapassa R$ 5,20 por cautela com Treasuries InfoMoney
trechos: Publicidade O dólar opera com forte alta perante o real nesta quinta-feira (1º), acompanhando o avanço da moeda norte-americana ante outras divisas de países emergentes no exterior, em meio às preocupações persistentes com a guerra no Oriente Médio.
Às 12h41, o dólar à vista opera com alta de 1,08%, a R$ 5,231 na venda.
O dólar futuro para novembro subia 0,02% na B3, aos R$ 5,215.
O dólar à vista encerrou a sessão de quarta-feira com queda de 0,76%, aos R$5,1735.
Dólar comercial - Compra: R$ 5,230 - Venda: R$ 5,231 O que aconteceu com dólar hoje?
O dólar voltou a ganhar força e ultrapassou o patamar dos R$ 5,20 no mercado à vista.

Outubro começa com o Brent perto de US$ 100 o barril, o juro do Treasury de 10 anos acima de 5,3% e o dólar em alta no exterior, cenário que favorece uma demanda cambial mais defensiva, segundo o economista Lucas Galdino, especialista de Câmbio na B&T XP.

itens.titulo: Petrobras aumenta preço do QAV em 11,8% às distribuidoras
itens.descricao: Petrobras aumenta preço do QAV em 11,8% às distribuidoras CNN Brasil
trechos: A Petrobras anunciou o aumento de 11,8% no preço de venda do QAV (querosene de aviação) às distribuidoras a partir desta quinta-feira (1º).
"O reajuste anunciado reflete a elevação das cotações internacionais do Querosene de Aviação, ocasionado pelo recrudescimento das tensões geopolíticas no Oriente Médio", disse a companhia.
O reajuste de outubro se dá após uma alta média de cerca de 13,9% nos preços em setembro, comparado com agosto.
No acumulado de 2026, o aumento é de 53,3%, correspondente a R$ 1,94 por litro em comparação ao preço vigente em dezembro de 2025.
Ainda no comunicado, a petroleira informou a alta dentre seus principais pontos de venda, sendo: - Guarulhos (SP): 11,6% - Duque de Caxias (RJ): 12% - Betim (MG): 11,6%

itens.titulo: What It Actually Takes for Bank of America to Keep Raising Its Dividend
itens.descricao: What It Actually Takes for Bank of America to Keep Raising Its Dividend Yahoo Finance
trechos: Quick Read -       Bank of America raised its quarterly dividend to $0.32, but its 11.2% CET1 ratio sits just 1.2 points above the 10% regulatory floor.
-       JPMorgan's 14.3% and Citigroup's 13.2% CET1 ratios give peers far more capital to return while BAC's 8% loan growth consumes its buffer.
-       BAC spent $6B on buybacks versus $2B on dividends in Q2, treating repurchases as the flexible valve that protects the sticky dividend commitment.

-       Read More: Learn 7 ways to generate income with a $1,000,000+ portfolio (sponsor) Bank of America (NYSE:BAC) raised its quarterly common dividend to $0.32 from $0.28, declared on July 24, 2026.
The annualized forward payout now stands at $1.28 per share.
Second-quarter EPS was $1.21, and the bank paid $2.0B in common dividends against $9.07B of net income.
Why Record Profits Still Hit a Capital Ceiling As a systemically important bank, Bank of America must hold common equity Tier 1 (CET1) capital above a regulatory floor.
JPMorgan Chase (NYSE:JPM) reported a 14.3% CET1 ratio in Q1 2026, and Citigroup (NYSE:C) ended 2025 at 13.2%.

itens.titulo: Coherent Jumps 10% on PhotonLink Push and Bernstein’s Outperform Start; Lumentum Rises 9%, Corning Advances 3%
itens.descricao: Coherent Jumps 10% on PhotonLink Push and Bernstein’s Outperform Start; Lumentum Rises 9%, Corning Advances 3% Yahoo Finance
trechos: -       Bernstein tagged Coherent, Lumentum, Ciena, and Arista as structural AI infrastructure winners, igniting a sector-wide rally led by Lumentum's 9% jump.
-       Lumentum's fiscal Q4 revenue surged 109% year over year to $1 billion, beating estimates, with optical-circuit-switch shipments doubling quarter over quarter.
Lumentum Holdings (NASDAQ:LITE) stock rose 9% to $1,058.42, while Corning (NYSE:GLW) stock advanced 3% to $158.89.
The Roundhill Photonics & Optics ETF (CBOE:LYTE) gained 4% to $25.40, while the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (NYSE ARCA:SPY) slipped 0.2% to $761.11.
Coherent said the platform includes more than 10 customer engagements for co-packaged optics and more than 10 customer engagements for near-packaged optics.
Bernstein said networking and optical suppliers could be "structural winners" within AI infrastructure, an assessment that helped reinforce investor interest in Coherent stock.
